q: What goes into the CBAM figure for DAP from Ras Al Khair?
title: Ras Al Khair DAP: the CBAM figure
short: DAP contains nitrogen, so it is a CBAM good. Its figure adds the ammonia it contains, made from local gas, to the phosphate plant's own fuel and power. Since the ammonia is made in the same complex, ask for that plant's measured figure rather than a default.
audience: EU importers of Saudi phosphate fertilisers and traders buying DAP and MAP

ul: Electricity, since indirect emissions count for fertilisers.

p: Phosphoric acid, sulphuric acid and phosphate rock are outside CBAM, though their energy enters the DAP figure through the plant.
Saudi Arabia has no carbon price that an importer could deduct.

senseible: Senseible keeps each site's fuel, power and production records together, so the embedded emissions you send an EU importer trace back to dated documents.
